resources.string: Cloud Settings Backup
Experimental storage in your Discord account. Manually save or restore local client preferences, customizations, and ordinary plugin settings. No automatic uploads.
Save Local Settings to Cloud
Restore Local Settings from Cloud

Replace your Microcord cloud backup with this installation\'s local settings? Credentials, account caches, plugin approval certificates, and Android permissions are excluded. Unrecognized remote data will not be overwritten. Plugins must not store secrets in ordinary settings.

Replace local settings and customization layouts from your cloud backup, then restart Microcord? Active calls will disconnect. Discord-synced preferences, credentials, plugin approvals, and Android permissions will not be changed. Plugin packages must already be installed.
Working on cloud backup...
Cloud backup saved and verified.
Local settings restored.
Settings restore failed. The pending backup is retained; retry from Feature Flags.
The cloud backup is missing, incompatible, or contains another client\'s data. No settings were overwritten.
Your cloud slot already contains data this version of Microcord cannot read. It was left untouched to avoid deleting an existing backup.
Could not prepare the settings backup: invalid data or an unsupported size. Nothing was uploaded.
Clear Cloud Data

Permanently clear the existing data in the experimental cloud backup field? This can delete a backup created by another client. Your local settings and other Discord settings will not be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Cloud data cleared and verified. You can now save a new backup.
Could not safely clear and verify the cloud data. It may have changed on another client. Try again.
The backup changed or could not be verified. Try again.
Settings recovery could not finish. The original snapshot is retained. Retry recovery before using Microcord; check that enough storage is available.
